work_types.description: Create, modify, diagnose, review, or reason about source code, scripts, software projects, APIs, or program behavior.
examples: add a feature to an application

work_types.description: Gather, compare, verify, synthesize, or analyze information from sources when the primary output is knowledge rather than a document artifact.
Create, edit, transform, summarize, extract from, or analyze document-like content where the document or written artifact is the main object of work.
Create, edit, transform, inspect, script, or coordinate video and audiovisual project work.
Store, retrieve, curate, reconcile, or structure durable knowledge in Knowledge Core or another knowledge system.
Operate, configure, inspect, or troubleshoot local operating-system, process, service, runtime, package, device, or host-level state when software development is not the primary task.
examples: configure a runtime on this computer

work_types.description: A valid request that does not fit another configured specialized work type closely enough to justify specialized routing.
